summary: Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 10,000,000 units at $10.00/unit, raising $100M gross proceeds. Simultaneously, it completed a private placement of 370,000 units at $10.00/unit to sponsor Next Lion Sponsor Holdings LLC and BTIG, LLC, raising an additional $3.7M. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half redeemable warrant ($11.50 exercise price). The SPAC now has $103.7M in trust. Filed as a blank-check company IPO. Next watch: target acquisition announcement within 24 months or liquidation.
